sources.title: Hongya Cave (Hongyadong): Most Iconic Landmark of Chongqing
sources.content:
Hongya Cave is an 11-floor, 75-meter-tall Diaojiaolou, or stilt building, standing against a cliff in Chongqing where the Yangtze and Jialing Rivers meet. The structure spans 46,000 square meters and exemplifies Ba-Yu traditional architecture.

Hours: 9 am-11 pm daily. Lights: 7:30 pm-11 pm. Cost: Free entry.

Floor Breakdown:
Level 1: Riverside pedestrian street with street food and folk art
Level 2: Bar and nightclub district
Level 3: Traditional Ba-Yu shops and restaurants
Level 4: Street food vendors and stalls
Level 5: International dining with river views
Level 6: 27.5-meter Ba culture pillar displaying Chongqing history
Level 7: Guo Xuanchang memorial sculpture hall
Level 8: Local specialty shopping
Level 9: Folk art and traditional craft sculptures
Level 10: Artificial waterfall viewpoint
Level 11: Observation deck overlooking Jialing River

Food: Almost every iconic Chongqing food including hotpot, spicy malatang, shihuishi skewers, sour rice noodles, wontons, and cold rice cake.

Night Experience: After dark the warm yellow lights create a dreamlike atmosphere reminiscent of Spirited Away's bathhouse. Peak hours 7:30-10 pm on weekends; visiting after 9:30 pm or on weekdays offers quieter exploration.

Photography Locations: Qiansimen Bridge, Riverside Park near Grand Theater, 11th-floor observation deck, road opposite Level 1. Saturday drone shows at 21:00 (May-Sept) or 20:30 (Oct-Apr).

Visitor Tips: Wear comfortable shoes. Use metros Lines 1, 2, or 6. Avoid taxis during rush hours. Request "微辣" (mild spice) if sensitive to heat. Hold railings; some cliff areas lack barriers. Expect 1-hour elevator waits during peak times.

Recommended Visit Duration: 2-4 hours, ideally visiting at dusk.

sources.title: Hongyadong: Explore Chongqing's Iconic Stilted Building Complex
sources.content:
Hongyadong is a striking architectural complex in Chongqing featuring traditional stilted buildings clinging to a cliff face along the Jialing River. The complex was completed in 2006, paying homage to diaojiaolou (traditional stilted buildings) heritage while incorporating modern construction techniques.

Hongyadong comprises 11 floors offering varied experiences, serving as a gate to the city and a bustling commercial hub for centuries.

Food Street: Visitors can sample Chongqing specialties including Xiaomian (small noodles) and hot pot offerings. Handicrafts & Souvenirs: Traditional Chinese paintings and intricate wood carvings available.

Hours: Open 24 hours a day, but shops and restaurants generally operate from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Best Time: Visit during day for architecture exploration; night visits showcase illuminated spectacle.

Transportation: Access via Chongqing Rail Transit Line 6 or Line 1 to Xiaoshizi Station.

sources.title: Hongya Cave in Chongqing, Hongyadong - Travel China Guide
sources.content:
Hongyadong is not actually a cave, but an 11-floor, 75-meter tall stilt building stood up against a cliff. It is popular with tourists because it has a similar appearance to a building in Spirited Away by Hayao Miyazaki.

Between 18:30 to 23:00, Hongya Cave will be illuminated, making it the ideal time to snap photos. The 11th floor entrance is generally more convenient for transportation, closer to Xiaoshizi Station (Line 1) and Linjiangmen Station (Line 2), about a 10-minute walk from Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street.

Hongyadong has a lot of street snacks with reasonable prices and a food street filled with a variety of local Chongqing snacks. The lights reflect on the Jialing River, making it one of the most photographed spots in Chongqing.

sources.title: Hongya Cave (2026) - Chongqing - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Hongya Cave visitor reviews from Tripadvisor. A must-see in Chongqing, especially at night when the buildings are lit up. Free entry. Can get extremely crowded on weekends and holidays. The food street offers great local snacks. Walking across Qiansimen Bridge at night gives the best view of Hongyadong. Consider visiting twice - once during the day and once at night.

sources.title: Hongyadong in Chongqing: architectural marvel
sources.content: Hongyadong in Chongqing is an architectural marvel. The modern Hongyadong was completed in 2006, and is a stunning blend of old and new, a towering cascade of wooden structures, intricate carvings, and glowing lanterns. When night falls, the wooden dwellings are lit up with neon lights, putting tourists into the vivid fairy world described in Spirited Away.

sources.title: 洪崖洞_百度百科
sources.content:
洪崖洞是重庆市渝中区的国家AAAA级旅游景区，位于嘉陵江滨江路88号，地处长江、嘉陵江两江交汇处。景区分为11层，高达79米，总占地面积3.15万平方米。

开放时间：11:00-23:00
门票：免费（需现场扫码预约）
特色项目：梦游巴渝十二景光影互动艺术空间39元/人；重逢1980街区加全息MR互动音乐秀套票29元/人

历史背景：战国时期为军事要塞，宋代为石窟寺庙。明朝洪武四年（1371年）洪崖门始为闭门。清代发展成繁荣码头，属重庆贸易中心。2006年景区建成并开业，2018年因灯光系统升级成为全国网红地标。

主要景观：吊脚楼建筑群、洪崖滴翠、洪崖汉阙、纸盐河街江畔酒吧街、天成巷巴渝风情街、美食街及城市阳台异域风情街等。

交通方式：公交111、112、114路等可直达；轨道2号线临江门站、1/6号线小什字站。

sources.title: Hongyadong | ichongqing
sources.content: Hongyadong is Chongqing's most iconic landmark, a 11-story stilted building complex built against a cliff overlooking the Jialing River. The complex features traditional Ba-Yu architecture, food streets, shopping areas, and stunning night views. Free entry. Open 24 hours. Best viewed at night when illuminated. Located in Yuzhong District near the confluence of the Yangtze and Jialing Rivers.
